description:
Crawl a whole site and audit it: the homepage, the sitemap and every internal link (robots.txt respected), up to max_pages, then 170+ Semrush-style checks graded error / warning / notice, a Site Health score (0–100) and 9 theme scores (crawlability, HTTPS, international SEO, Core Web Vitals, performance, internal linking, markup, AI search, on-page).

Billing: 1¢ per 10 pages fetched (1,000 pages = $1.00, 10,000 = $10.00), billed as it crawls; the link, image and script checks (up to 5,000 per crawl), the site checks (HTTPS, www, TLS, soft 404, llms.txt, AI fetchers) and Core Web Vitals on up to 10 pages are included at no extra charge. It stops as "partial" if the balance runs out. Confirm max_pages and the most it can cost with the user first.

Timing: about 3–6 pages a second, then a short link-check and scoring stage; Core Web Vitals follow a few minutes after completion (cwv_state "pending" until then; their theme only, never Site Health). It runs ~40 s in this call: a small site comes back complete, a bigger one returns status "running" and keeps crawling in the background — read it later with get_latest_crawl (free). One page instead: run_technical_audit.

Inputs: site_id (list_sites), max_pages (1–10000, default the whole site), seed_url (optional, on the site). Optional settings (source, include/exclude, ignore_params, subdomains, robots_agent, device, speed, cwv_urls): see each input; leave them out to crawl the whole site.

Returns: { run_id, site_id, status: running|complete|partial|failed, stage, coverage, pages_crawled, pages_found, pages_failed, skipped_by_rules, charged_cents, billed_cents (same), max_cost_cents, settings?, rejected?, site_health, counts: { errors, warnings, notices }, themes, cwv_state, checks: [{ id, severity, title, n, of }] (failing, worst first, ≤30), issues_summary (counts), top_problem_pages (≤5: { url, http_status, checks }), note, next_step }. While running, checks are provisional page counts so far. For one check's URLs, evidence and fix call get_crawl_issue (free).

cwv_urls.description: Up to 10 pages on the site to measure Core Web Vitals on, instead of the automatic sample.

device.description: desktop (default) or mobile user agent (both AuditAE-Bot).

exclude.description: Skip URLs whose path+query matches one of these masks (same syntax as include; exclude beats include). Skipped URLs count in skipped_by_rules.

exclude_checks.description: Check ids (checks[].id) to leave out of Site Health and the theme scores; they report not_run 'excluded'.

ignore_params.description: Query parameters to drop from URLs (e.g. ["sort", "page_*"]); ["*"] drops every query string.

include.description: Only crawl URLs whose path+query matches one of these masks (robots.txt syntax: * wildcard, $ end, else prefix; /shoes also matches /shoes-men, /shoes/ is the folder). The homepage is always fetched.

max_pages.description: Most pages to crawl, 1–10000. Default 10000. 1¢ per 10 pages.

robots_agent.description: Obey this bot's robots.txt group instead of User-agent: * (e.g. OAI-SearchBot to see the site as ChatGPT search may crawl it). The crawler still identifies as AuditAE-Bot.

save_as_default.description: true: also save these settings (not urls) as the site's default for later crawls and schedules.

seed_url.description: Optional start URL on the site's own domain.

sitemap_url.description: source=sitemap_url: the sitemap file or index to crawl; must be on the site.

source.description: What to crawl: site (default: links + sitemap), sitemaps (only the sitemaps' URLs), sitemap_url (one sitemap file), urls (only the listed URLs, plus the homepage). Default: the site's saved crawl settings, else site.

speed.description: normal (default, 3 at a time), polite (1 page a second; 10,000 pages ≈ 3 h) or robots (robots.txt Crawl-delay, max 10 s).

subdomains.description: Also crawl subdomains of the site's domain (each obeys its own robots.txt; up to 25 hosts). Default false.

urls.description: source=urls: up to 2,000 URLs on the site (off-site ones are rejected and returned in rejected). max_pages is clamped to the list.

name: crawl_site
title: Crawl a whole site (up to 10,000 pages) and run a Site Audit
